desktop_wrapper.observed_lifecycle: Electron app waits for SillyTavern SERVER_STARTED event, receives the actual server URL and loads it into BrowserWindow; window close quits the desktop process on non-macOS.

runtime_install_observation: The upstream src/electron/start.sh performs npm install before normal launch. FA3 does not adopt that runtime mutation semantics; dependency preparation is a separate explicit admission step and ordinary desktop launch is dependency-install-free.
security_observation: The 1.18.0 release notes explicitly reference a security incident involving the third-party Bot Browser extension and advise users to review the maintainers statement. FA3 treats third-party extensions as separately admitted supply-chain/runtime components.
